findings.summary: Metric redaction can be bypassed through whitelisted metric values.
findings.details: createBrainMetric only removes unsafe field names before copying whitelisted metric keys. If customer text, a prompt fragment, provider payload, or raw source text is passed as errorTag/status/workspaceId/brainKey/sourceHash/evalVersion, it is emitted unchanged. The tests prove named canaries are dropped from disallowed keys, but they do not assert value-shape constraints for the fields the helper keeps, so the documented IDs/hashes/counts/durations/status/error-tag-only boundary is false-green for whitelisted fields.
